confirmed_task: In psf/requests, filter to open non-draft pull requests and sort by most recently updated. Inspect the first three results. For each, report number, title, author, last-updated date, labels, changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whethe any test file is included in Files changed. Rank the three by changed-file count. Stopping condition: stop after all three pull requests and their file-change summaries have been verified. Constraints: do not sign in; do not review, comment, react, merge, close, or modify pull requests; count only information GitHub displays.

items.criterion: Filter and sort pull request list correctly (open, non-draft, most recently updated)
items.description: Navigate to psf/requests PR list and attempt to constrain results to: Open PRs, excluding Draft PRs, sorted by most recently updated. Full credit if the agent uses GitHub UI controls and/or query syntax to achieve the intended list, OR if GitHub UI/unauthenticated limitations prevent perfect filtering/sorting and the agent clearly states the limitation and uses the closest available visible ordering/filtering (e.g., Open + Updated sorting, with an explicit check/statement about drafts). Partial credit if the agent inspects PRs from an unsorted/unfiltered list without explaining why. No credit if the agent clearly uses Closed PRs or includes Draft PRs without noting it when non-draft options were visible.

items.criterion: Inspect and report PR #1 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
items.description: For the first (most recently updated) qualifying PR from the filtered/sorted list, report: number, title, author, last-updated date, labels (as shown), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file is included in the Files changed tab (verified by viewing the file list). Full credit if all fields are reported exactly as GitHub displays, OR if the agent clearly attempts to open the PR and Files changed but GitHub does not display some fields (e.g., Files changed fails to load, rate-limited, partial file list) and the agent explicitly states which fields could not be verified and why. Partial credit if one or two fields are missing without explanation, or if test-file presence is stated without indicating the Files changed list was checked when it was accessible.

items.criterion: Inspect and report PR #2 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
items.description: For the second PR in the filtered/sorted list, report: number, title, author, last-updated date, labels (as shown), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file is included in Files changed (verified by viewing the file list). Full credit if all fields match GitHub display, OR if the agent clearly attempts to verify each field but GitHub does not display some information to an unauthenticated user and the agent documents the blocker and unverified fields. Partial credit if minor omissions occur without explanation or if test-file status is unverified when Files changed was accessible.

items.criterion: Inspect and report PR #3 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
items.description: For the third PR in the filtered/sorted list, report: number, title, author, last-updated date, labels (as shown), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file is included in Files changed (verified by viewing the file list). Full credit if all fields match GitHub display, OR if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but GitHub does not display some information and the agent clearly reports which parts could not be verified due to external/UI limitations. Partial credit for small omissions without explanation or unclear test-file verification when accessible.

items.criterion: Rank the three PRs by changed-file count
items.description: After inspecting all three, rank them by changed-file count in a clearly stated order. Full credit if the ordering matches the changed-file counts the agent reported (or, if counts could not be verified due to GitHub display issues, the agent explicitly states ranking is not possible and why). Partial credit if ranking is provided but contains a minor ordering error attributable to earlier reporting inconsistency.

items.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no PR actions; stop after verifying three summaries)
items.description: Do not sign in; do not review, comment, react, merge, close, or otherwise modify PRs; rely only on information GitHub displays. Stop after all three PRs and their file-change summaries have been verified, or after clearly reporting an unavoidable blocker preventing verification. Full credit if no prohibited actions occur and the agent stops appropriately; do not penalize necessary extra page loads/refreshes/navigation undertaken solely to verify the three PRs due to GitHub UI/load issues. Partial credit if the agent browses slightly beyond the three PRs but still does not violate constraints.
